clue.text: Insect that's always flourished in marshy borders

indicators.note: in says the two short pieces sit inside the outer letters
borders means only the edge letters of marshy are used

parts.note: AY is an old and poetic word for always
fl. is the abbreviation of floruit, Latin for flourished, used in dates of historical figures

explanation.surface: A nature note about an insect that has always thrived on the edges of marshland.
explanation.definitionFit: The mayfly is a short-lived winged insect found near fresh water, so it is an example of the general term.

clue.text: Gypsum dog framed by a flowering plant

indicators.note: framed by says the dog sits inside the pair of words that follow, as a picture inside its frame

parts.note: the aster is a daisy-like garden flower
a lab is short for a Labrador dog

explanation.surface: A picture of a dog surrounded by flowers, oddly linked to a mineral.
explanation.definitionFit: Alabaster is a fine-grained, translucent form of gypsum used for carving ornaments.

clue.text: Butter up female, second of two

parts.note: the latter is the second of two things mentioned

explanation.surface: Instructions to sweet-talk a woman, oddly qualified as the second of a pair.
explanation.definitionFit: To butter someone up is to praise them insincerely to win favour, an idiom matching the verb.

clue.text: Long-haired bovine a woman raised

indicators.note: raised means read upwards, so in this down clue the name is turned backwards

parts.note: Kay is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A woman has reared a shaggy-coated cow.
explanation.definitionFit: The yak is a shaggy ox of the Himalayas and Tibet, kept for milk, wool and transport.

clue.text: SE European fellow seen with another at bar

parts.note: Al is a man's name, a fellow
to ban is to bar
Ian is another man's name

explanation.surface: A man from south-east Europe is spotted with a friend at the pub bar.
explanation.definitionFit: Albania lies in south-east Europe on the Adriatic, so a native of that country is a south-east European.

clue.text: Like soldiers initially welcoming times in Gulf

indicators.note: welcoming means taking in, so the other piece goes inside

parts.note: as means like
by means times, as in three by four

indicators.note: initially means take the first letter of soldiers

explanation.surface: A military report about soldiers welcoming visitors in the Gulf.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gulf' looks like the Persian Gulf of the military scene, but here it is the definition, a deep chasm.
explanation.definitionFit: A gulf can mean a deep chasm or vast gap, which is what an abyss is.

clue.text: Anchor possibly thrown in wide English river

indicators.note: in says the throw sits inside the other letters

parts.note: broad means wide
R is the map abbreviation for river
cast means thrown

explanation.surface: A ship's anchor perhaps tossed into a broad English river.
explanation.walkthrough: The anchor here is not a ship's: it is a news anchor, who presents the programme.
explanation.definitionFit: A news anchor presents a programme on air, one example of somebody whose job is transmitting to an audience; possibly marks the example.

clue.text: Writer turned up with simple air — Holst wrote it

indicators.note: turned up means read upwards, so in this down clue the word is reversed

parts.note: a pen is something that writes
a tune is a simple air or melody

explanation.surface: A composer takes up his pen and writes a simple melody.
explanation.definitionFit: Gustav Holst's suite The Planets includes a movement named after the god of the sea and its planet, Neptune, the Mystic.

clue.text: Chilly grandmother's first to wear a hat

indicators.note: to wear means the piece goes under the hat, so it sits inside

parts.note: lid is slang for a hat

indicators.note: first means the opening letter of grandmother's

explanation.surface: A chilly granny is first to put on a hat.
explanation.definitionFit: Algid is a formal, rare word meaning cold, used especially in medicine.

clue.text: Manly youth leader carrying chest? Nonsense

indicators.note: carrying means holding, so the chest goes inside

parts.note: male means manly
an ark is a chest or box, as in the Ark of the Covenant

indicators.note: leader means the first letter of youth

explanation.surface: A manly youth leader lugging a box is dismissed as rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: Malarkey is informal American slang for foolish talk or humbug.

clue.text: Call into question work finally undertaken by dog

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work
a pug is a small dog

indicators.note: finally means the last letter of undertaken

explanation.surface: Someone queries a job that a dog has eventually taken on.
explanation.definitionFit: Oppugn is a formal word meaning to dispute or question the truth of something.

clue.text: Had visions of G-man arresting worker in present state

indicators.note: arresting means holding, so the other pieces go inside

parts.note: a G-man, an FBI agent, is called a fed in American slang
an ant is the classic crossword worker
as is means in the present state, unaltered

explanation.surface: An FBI agent arrests a worker and dreams of something.
explanation.definitionFit: To fantasise about something is to imagine or daydream it, the same as having visions of it.

clue.text: Swimmer displaying roughness if disturbed

indicators.note: disturbed means shaken up, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A swimmer shows how rough the water is when stirred up.
explanation.definitionFit: The surgeonfish is a tropical reef fish with blade-like spines, an example of a creature that swims.

clue.text: Ancient city originally developing universal language

parts.note: Ur is the ancient city of Mesopotamia

indicators.note: originally means the first letter of developing

parts.note: U is the film-rating abbreviation for universal

explanation.surface: An ancient city is said to have developed a universal language.
explanation.definitionFit: Urdu is the national language of Pakistan, widely spoken in India too.

clue.text: Celebrity extremely short with retired painter

indicators.note: extremely means take the outer letters of short
retired means withdrawn, so the letters go backwards

parts.note: RA, Royal Academician, is the crossword painter

explanation.surface: A famous figure, very small, spends time with a painter who has stopped working.
explanation.definitionFit: A star is a famous performer, so a celebrity.

clue.text: Unruly adolescent initially involved with same group

indicators.note: involved means tangled, so the letters are rearranged
initially means the first letter of adolescent

explanation.surface: A wild teenager gets mixed up with a particular gang.
explanation.definitionFit: Rampageous is an old word for rowdy and violent, behaving as if on a rampage.

clue.text: Extinct bird's endless complaint

indicators.note: endless means the final letter is cut off

parts.note: a moan is a complaint

explanation.surface: The constant grumble of a bird that has died out.
explanation.definitionFit: The moa was a giant flightless bird of New Zealand, hunted to extinction centuries ago.

clue.text: Apathy shown by a Continental business

parts.note: un is French for a, so a Continental word for a
a concern is a business or firm

explanation.surface: A European company displays a lack of interest.
explanation.definitionFit: Unconcern is indifference or lack of interest, which is what apathy means.

clue.text: Unconnected Irish soldiers allowed to secure transport

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, British army soldiers

indicators.note: to secure means to hold fast, so the transport goes inside

parts.note: let means allowed
a van is a means of transport

explanation.surface: Irish troops permitted to grab a vehicle have no link to anything.
explanation.definitionFit: Something irrelevant has no bearing on the matter in hand, so it is not connected.

clue.text: Friendly understanding hospital department twice exploited at first

indicators.note: twice says the department's letters are written a second time, one copy after the other

parts.note: ENT is the ear, nose and throat department of a hospital

indicators.note: at first means the opening letter of exploited

explanation.surface: A cordial deal is exploited early on by one hospital department, twice over.
explanation.definitionFit: An entente is a friendly agreement between nations, as in the Entente Cordiale of 1904.

clue.text: Ancient northerner chosen to be heard

indicators.note: to be heard means the word is spoken, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: picked means chosen

explanation.surface: An old northern figure is selected to be given a hearing.
explanation.definitionFit: The Picts were an ancient people of northern and eastern Scotland.

clue.text: Panto character's mistake, briefly entering orchestra area

indicators.note: entering means going into, so the shortened mistake goes inside

parts.note: the pit is the area below the stage where the orchestra plays

indicators.note: briefly means the word is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: an error is a mistake

explanation.surface: A pantomime actor's blunder when briefly wandering into the orchestra pit.
explanation.walkthrough: Panto is short for pantomime, the British Christmas stage show.
explanation.definitionFit: Pierrot is the sad white-faced clown of French mime, a stock figure in British pantomime and seaside shows.

clue.text: Vegetable patch sometimes lost by the inattentive?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a small piece of ground for growing vegetables
second meaning: the storyline, which people who lose concentration lose

explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both an allotment of ground and the storyline that the idiom 'lose the' it refers to.

clue.text: Section of popular Gorecki composition

indicators.note: Section of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Part of a well-loved piece by the Polish composer Gorecki.
explanation.definitionFit: A largo is a piece or movement played slowly and broadly, so a musical composition.

clue.text: A loner's source of Dixieland jazz?

parts.note: a new arrangement of the letters of a loner's spells the second word, so 'new' plus that rearrangement describes the clue words

explanation.surface: A solitary person's sort of music is Dixieland.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as wordplay: the first word signals a fresh arrangement of the second word's letters, giving the clue's 'A loner's'.
explanation.definitionFit: Dixieland, early traditional jazz, grew up in this Louisiana city in the early twentieth century.

clue.text: Game fellow finally greeting saint

indicators.note: finally means the last letter of fellow

parts.note: hi is a greeting

explanation.surface: A man finally says hello to a holy figure over a game.
explanation.definitionFit: Whist is a card game for four players in two partnerships, a forerunner of bridge.

clue.text: British academic institution inspiring eastern sultanate

indicators.note: inspiring means breathing in, so the letter goes inside

parts.note: uni is short for university

explanation.surface: A British university motivates an Eastern state ruled by a sultan.
explanation.definitionFit: Brunei, on Borneo, is a small oil-rich state ruled by a sultan.

clue.text: Sneak attending class with hesitation

parts.note: in means attending, present
a form is a school class in Britain
er is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: A schoolchild telltale goes to lessons, hesitating.
explanation.definitionFit: A sneak is someone who tells tales on others, a schoolyard name for one who passes on information.

clue.text: Almost tumble in Cornish river

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the final letter is dropped

parts.note: a fall is a tumble

explanation.surface: Someone nearly falls into a river in Cornwall.
explanation.definitionFit: The Fal is a river in Cornwall, the county at Britain's south-west tip, flowing to Falmouth.

clue.text: Distribute headgear around Maine, to a certain extent

indicators.note: around says the first word's letters wrap round the state

parts.note: to sow is to scatter or distribute seed
ME is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Maine
a hat is headgear

explanation.surface: Hand out hats around the state of Maine, up to a point.
explanation.definitionFit: Somewhat means in part or to some degree, a direct synonym.

clue.text: It's accepted by two US cities as a form of prayer

indicators.note: accepted by means taken in, so the word goes inside

parts.note: LA is Los Angeles and NY is New York
it, with the 's standing for is as a link

explanation.surface: Something is welcomed by two American cities as a kind of prayer.
explanation.definitionFit: A litany is a series of petitions recited by a leader with responses from the congregation.
